title: T23 playbooks: round-one theme palettes (0.5.1)
head: t23-palettes
body:
## What

- `themes/<id>/theme.yaml` for the 8 round-one themes (`arcade`, `desert`, `hitchhiker`, `office`, `robot`, `space`, `fantasy`, `pets`), light + dark, each drawn from its avatar set's art; `avatar` hint = own id
- Type, radius, motion and sounds copied from Lantern unchanged (sounds stay `default`)
- `lamp` stays warm amber everywhere (decision #167): bright gold in dark, deep amber (hue 36°) in light so it clears 3:1 against `bg`
- Muted-text audit (owner check: muted/secondary text token on `bg` AND `surface`/`surface-raised`, light AND dark, ≥4.5:1): `garage.themes.validate.TEXT_PAIRS` already checked `text-muted` this way before this PR — no checker change needed, confirmed with a fresh read of the code and its existing per-pair/per-variant tests
- Shipped palettes (9 of 9 pass every check, muted-text included) — lowest muted-text ratio per palette:
  - `arcade`: 6.08 — pass
  - `desert`: 6.02 — pass
  - `fantasy`: 6.00 — pass
  - `hitchhiker`: 5.70 — pass
  - `lantern`: 6.07 — pass
  - `office`: 5.87 — pass
  - `pets`: 6.12 — pass
  - `robot`: 5.75 — pass
  - `space`: 6.12 — pass
- Held palettes: none — all 9 pass `validate_theme` with `[]` and the muted-text floor
- Lantern light lamp, owner decision: `themes/lantern/theme.yaml`'s `light.colors.lamp` is now `200 120 0` (was `240 181 69`, ~1.69:1) — ~3.14:1 against `light.bg` (`#f7f5f0`), clears decision #167's 3:1 `lamp`/`bg` rule. Dark lamp unchanged. This was shown as a preview-only candidate in 0.5.0/round one; now applied, closing Lantern's one known gap — `validate_theme(themes/lantern)` now returns `[]`, and `tests/test_themes_shipped.py`'s full-pass parametrize list includes `lantern` again
- `tests/test_themes_validate.py`: the two lantern-specific tests flip to assert `[]` / the new ~3.14:1 ratio; `PARITY_CASES`' "lantern unchanged" case flips to `mirror_pass=True`
- Preview for Braden: `coordination/references/themes/preview.html` (+ `preview-full.png`, `preview-<id>.png`)
- playbooks stays 0.5.1 (already bumped by the palettes commit; `pyproject.toml`, `uv.lock` unchanged here), `CHANGELOG.md` 0.5.1 bullets added for the lamp change and the muted-text audit

## Mutation check

No gate or state mapping: data files; tests/test_themes_shipped.py fails if any shipped theme drops below AA (proved by lowering one text colour, then restoring). Mutant: office light `text-muted` `#555961` → `#9a9da3`; killed by `test_shipped_theme_passes_validator[office]`.
